subject: Battlefield
text: Clearing the Battlefield with Phanquid and Sphinx rewards the Exit spell.

evidence.quote:
=================
Enemies - Phanquid + Sphinx
Reward - Exit [Spell]
=================...Your reward, is a new 
spell! Exit!

subject: Phanquid
text: Use the Knight Sword on enemies, or use a Jumbo Bomb if the Knight Sword is not taking out the Phanquids.

evidence.quote:
Just use your Knight Sword on the enemies - Or use a Jumbo Bomb, if your
Knight Sword isn't taking out the Phanquids.

subject: Battlefield
text: The Battlefield left of the previous one yields a reward of 744 EXP.

evidence.quote:
=================
Enemies - Freezer Crab + Gather
Reward - 744 EXP
=================

Left of the previous Battlefield, is another Battlefield....This time, the reward is a boost in EXP.

subject: Gather
text: Bombs are effective against Gather due to its weakness, though the Knight Sword also works.

evidence.quote:
Bombs are 
good here, due to the Gather's weakness. Although, the Knight Swoord 
should also work.

subject: Cloaked man
text: The cloaked man tells you to seek a person named Reuben in Fireburg.

evidence.quote:
Head down 
them, to talk to that cloaked man again. He'll tell you to seek a person
named Reuben in Fireburg, and then leave.

subject: Venus Shield
text: Bomb the door on the left and unlock it with the Venus Key to get the Venus Shield.

evidence.quote:
If you bomb the door on the left, you can walk through, and get the 
Venus Shield. Well, you can as long as you got the Venus Key... You 
did, didn't you?

subject: Blizzard
text: A Blizzard spell can be collected on the left side of the room.

evidence.quote:
There's also a Blizzard Spell on the left side of the
room, so get that as well.

subject: Statue
text: Move the statue so it sits one space right of the metal/stone block on the bottom wall.

evidence.quote:
Now, about that statue... Move it, so that it's one space right of the 
metal/stone block, on the bottom wall. This is important, any other
spot will not work.

subject: Focus Tower
text: Enter Focus Tower near Libra Temple, go down the first stairs, and open the River Coin door.

evidence.quote:
Now, leave Focuse Tower, and enter it again through
the entrance near Libra Temple. Head down the first set of stairs, go
around, and open the River Coin door; Continue ahead, through the next
door.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Jump across to the platform using the statue, proceed left and up through the stairs, and check the chest for potions.

evidence.quote:
Use it to jump across to the other platform. Go left,
and up, until you reach some stairs. Go through them, and check the
treasure chest for some potions.

subject: Battlefield
text: Clearing the Battlefield containing only Jellys yields a reward of 900 GP.

evidence.quote:
=================
Enemies - Jelly
Reward - 900 GP
=================

This battlefield contais some new types of enemy; Particularly, of the
element of fire. This one contains only Jellys, so use bombs; Remember,
enemies of the Slime family hate bombs. The reward this time, is a pile
of GP.

subject: Battlefield
text: Clearing the Battlefield of Jellys and Sting Rats rewards the Gemini Crest.

evidence.quote:
=================
Enemies - Jelly + String Rat
Reward - Gemini Crest
=================

This Battlefield contains more Jellys, as well as Sting Rats....By doing so, you'll be rewarded
with the Gemini Crest - another stone, to enable you to use warps with
the Gemini symbol on them!

subject: Gemini Warp
text: A building in the north-west section of Aquaria has a Gemini Warp leading to Fireburg.

evidence.quote:
In fact, in the building in the north-west
section of Aquaria, there's a building with a Gemini Warp, leading to
Fireburg!

subject: Battlefield
text: Defeating all Plant Mans in the Battlefield rewards 816 EXP.

evidence.quote:
=================
Enemies - Plant Man
Reward - 816 EXP
=================

There's one more Battlefield between you and Fireburg now. It contains
only Plant Mans, so if you use your Axe, and are level 18 or so, one 
hit should take them out. Hack away, until the Battlefield is cleaned
out, and you'll get a reward of 816 EXP.

subject: Chest
text: Go inside the house Reuben lives in next to the hotel to get Refreshers from the chest.

evidence.quote:
Neighboring it, on the left, is the
house Reuben lives in. Go inside, and get some Refreshers from the
chest, then talk to Reuben.

subject: Reuben
text: Reuben joins the team on the condition that you help him rescue his dad.

evidence.quote:
He needs you to help him rescue his dad, so
he joins you, on the condition that you'll help; Reuben joins the team!

subject: Tristam
text: Talk to Tristam in the back of the hotel to receive the Multi-Key.

evidence.quote:
Enter the hotel, and walk to the back. Here,
you'll meet up with Tristam again. He'll give you a Multi-Key, and say
it should help you unlock the door of the guy's house.

subject: Mega Grenades
text: Climb down the wall outside the hotel using the Cat Claw to enter the house where a friend of Reuben's dad gives you the Mega Grenades.

evidence.quote:
The next order of buisness, is to get Mega Grenades from a friend of 
Reuben's dad....use Cat Claw, to climb down the wall, near the outside of
the hotel, down to where a house is. This time, you'll be able to enter.

He'll give you the Mega Grenades!

subject: Hotel
text: A guy back in the hotel sells seeds.

evidence.quote:
Oh, and before
you go, back in the hotel again, there's a guy that sells seeds.

subject: Man outside inn
text: You can buy explosives from a man outside the inn.

evidence.quote:
You can also 
buy some explosives from a man outside the inn, but they are a bit 
expensive...

subject: Lady in house
text: A lady in a house in the southern part of town sells the Battle Axe for 500GP.

evidence.quote:
Most importantly, however, is a house in the southern part
of town. A lady in it, will sell you a Battle Axe for 500GP - It's very
worth it!

subject: Battlefield
text: Clearing the battlefield west of Fireburg rewards 1200 GP.

evidence.quote:
=================
Enemies - Plant Man + Sting Rat + Flazzard
Reward  - 1200 GP
=================

There's another battlefield to the west of Fireurg....Clear
them all out, and you'll be getting a healthy boost in GP.

subject: Battlefield
text: Clearing 10 rounds of monsters at the battlefield north of the previous one yields the Wizard spell Thunder.

evidence.quote:
=================
Enemies - Flazzard + Red Cap
Reward  - Thunder [Spell]
=================

Again, you're going to be clearing out 10 rounds of monsters....Your first Wizard spell - Thunder!

subject: Chest
text: Inside the first bombable cave, the chest on the right contains Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
If you bomb the door on this platform, you can enter a cave
area....The chest on the right contains Heal
Potions, and the one on the left contains Potions.

subject: Chest
text: Inside the first bombable cave, the chest on the left contains Potions.

evidence.quote:
The chest on the right contains Heal
Potions, and the one on the left contains Potions.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Inside the cave guarded by two Red Bones past the bucket-pulley mechanism, a fancy treasure chest contains the Charm Claw.

evidence.quote:
On the right,
is a bucket+pully type mechanism. Ride it to the bottom. On your left,
there will be two Red Bones guarding another blocked door. Defeat them
and blow up the door. Once inside, fight your way around the right side
of the rocks, to reach a room with a fancy treasure chest. Inside, is
the upgrade to the Cat Claw, the Charm Claw!

subject: Chest
text: In the final optional cave behind bombable rocks, climb up to the second platform to find a chest full of bombs.

evidence.quote:
Keep moving south, until you reach another (and the final)
optional cave; You'll know the door, as always, it's blocked by bombable
rocks....Climb to the floor, where you'll
fight another Red Bone, than climb up to a second platform. Either climb
over, or fight the Zombie there, to reach a chest full of bombs.

subject: Jinn
text: Jinn is the boss of the Mine and has 6,000HP.

evidence.quote: Now, you're after Jinn, the boss of the Mine!...Jinn  - 6,000HP

subject: Jinn
text: Against Jinn, take out each Red Bone first, attack with Reuben every turn, and have Hero use Thunder followed by Quake.

evidence.quote:
Battle Strategy: Start this fight, by taking out     |
| GP: 15       | each red bone, who are fighting with him. When that's|
O--------------O done, use Reuben to attack every turn. Hero should   |
| Attack List  | use Thunder while it lasts, and Quake, when he's     |
| ===========  | out of Wizard magic.

subject: Chests
text: Outside the door Jinn was blocking, check the four chests to find bombs, Potions, and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
When he's defeated, exit the Mine through the door he was blocking. On
the outside, check the four chests, to get bombs, Potions, and Heal
Potions.

subject: Reuben
text: Reuben throws a Mega Grenade causing a huge boulder to roll away.

evidence.quote:
Reuben will
throw a Mega Grendade, and cause the huge boulder to roll away (causing
you to see a short cutscene of the world map.)

subject: Mine
text: From where you fought Jinn, defeat the Red Bone at the top, ride the left-moving belt, then the down belt, climb the platform, and take the left belt to return to the entrance.

evidence.quote:
To get back to the entrance, defeat the Red Bone near the top of the 
paltform where you fought Jinn, and take the conveyor belt he was 
blocking. Defeat another Red Bone at the top, to access the conveyor 
belt that's moving left. On the next platform, take the belt moving 
down, and then climb up to a new platform from there. One more belt -
The one moving left - will bring you back to the first platform. Exit
the mine, and head back to Fireburg.

subject: Reuben's father
text: Reuben's father tells you the Fire Crystal is in the Lava Dome.

evidence.quote:
By heading back to the house you found Reuben in, you'll find Reuben's
father, lying down. If you talk to him, he'll tell you the Fire Crystal
is in the Lava Dome.

subject: Boulder
text: The boulder moved earlier forms a bridge on the world map leading to the Sealed Temple.

evidence.quote:
On the worldmap, you should have noticed how the boulder you moved
earlier made a bridge to a temple? That is known as "Sealed Temple".
That's where you're going now.

subject: Treasure chests
text: Treasure chests in the back of the room in the Sealed Temple contain Cure Potions and Healing Potions.

evidence.quote:
After he leaves, get the Cure
Potions, and Healing Potions from the treasure chests in the back of the
room, then get on the Gemini warp pad, to be teleported to Wintry 
Temple.

subject: Gemini warp pad
text: Step on the Gemini warp pad in Sealed Temple to be teleported to Wintry Temple.

evidence.quote:
then get on the Gemini warp pad, to be teleported to Wintry 
Temple.

subject: Chests
text: Chests in Wintry Temple contain Cure Potions and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
Once in Wintry temple, you can get more Cure Potions and Heal Potions
from the chests, but nothing else.
